topology_tax.reading: One extra dispatch costs ~12-16 microseconds of GPU time on this genome, whether the extra work is 287 identical large gates or 401 mixed organs. Tiny ba (96x5120, 48 dispatches, ~12.5 MiB) is 0.09% of bytes and still pays a full launch. Encoder collapse (GPU_IDLE_GAP serial vs noop) left GPU_NS overlapping, so the tax is kernel launch / occupancy / stream restart, not encoder begin/end and not host catalog walk.
